_note: The eight places from the Scene Book. Bracketed names stay until Jim picks final names. Hours and descriptions are Claude's drafts, waiting on Jim. Positions are on a 0 to 100 map.

desc.default: Where mornings start and nights end.

bedroom.default: The bed, the nightstand, the lamp you never turn on.
bedroom.dawn: Blue light before the sun. The bed, the nightstand, the lamp you never turn on.
bedroom.night: Dark, except for whatever is lit on the nightstand.

kitchen.default: A counter, a sink, a fridge that hums louder than it should.
kitchen.dawn: The coffee maker blinks the wrong time. The counter is where you left it.

living.default: The couch, the TV, the lamp. The couch has a shape that's yours.
living.dusk: The lamp is on. The couch has a shape that's yours.
living.night: The lamp is on. The TV is waiting. The couch has a shape that's yours.

places.name: The job site

desc.default: Forms, rebar, a slab that will be a building. Ray's truck is parked where it's always parked.
desc.dawn: Floodlights still on. The crew drifts in with coffee.
desc.evening: The slab cools. Everybody's gone but the dust.

places.closedText: The gate is chained. The crew works weekdays, 7:00 to 3:30.

places.name: The diner

desc.default: [Marlene]'s diner. Regulars, coffee, and the news board by the register where town news lives.
desc.dawn: Warm light, the first pot on, three regulars who never sit anywhere else.
desc.morning: Warm light and the smell of the grill. The news board by the register is half covered in index cards.
desc.evening: The supper crowd is two tables and a pie case.

places.closedText: The sign says CLOSED. [Marlene] opens at 5:30 in the morning.

places.name: The gym

desc.default: [Deshawn]'s gym. Racks, rubber floors, a whiteboard with somebody's PR on it.
desc.dawn: Mostly empty. The lights hum. Somebody's left a towel on the bench.
desc.evening: Mostly empty at this hour. The radio plays to nobody.

places.closedText: Dark windows. The gym opens at 5:00 a.m.

places.name: [Tuck's]

desc.default: Low light, a long bar, the game on with the sound off.
desc.evening: The after-work crowd. The game is on with the sound off.
desc.night: Low light. The same six people. The neon in the window does most of the talking.

places.closedText: The neon is off. [Tuck's] opens at 4.

places.name: The church
places.hoursText: Open most days. The food pantry runs Thursdays, 4:30 to 6:30.

desc.default: White siding, a side door to the basement where the food pantry runs. [Pastor Ruth] coordinates it.
desc.morning: The side door is propped open. Somebody is sweeping the steps.

places.closedText: The doors are locked. A paper sign: PANTRY THURSDAYS 4:30 TO 6:30.

desc.default: A walking track around a field, and a bench by the river.
desc.dawn: Mist on the field. One walker ahead of you on the track.
desc.night: One light by the bench. The river is louder in the dark.

places.name: The gas station

desc.default: On [Main]. Four pumps, coffee that's been on since six, and a lot where things break down, sometimes literally.
desc.night: On [Main]. The canopy lights make everything look like an ad.

places.closedText: The pumps are dark. The gas station on [Main] opens at 5.
